title: Whisper Program 1 artifacts v1
description: Closed corpus manifests, retained execution evidence, typed claims, verifier-issued classifications, Diagnostic UI acceptance, and Program 1 completion.

I64.$comment: Runtime validation rejects values outside -9223372036854775808 through 9223372036854775807.

PackageArtifactPath.$comment: The ASCII package-relative grammar also excludes absolute paths, empty components, dot components, backslashes, and drive prefixes. Prose additionally rejects symlinks, nonregular files, duplicate paths, and package-root escape.

ArtifactRefs.$comment: Prose requires strict tuple ordering and uniqueness and at most one reference per role.

DatagramReceipts.$comment: Prose requires strict numeric order and uniqueness by order.

CorpusInputDatagramReceipts.$comment: Prose requires strict numeric order and uniqueness by order.

ScreenshotLocators.$comment: The sole locator binds the sole BrowserTrace screenshot event; prose additionally requires global path uniqueness, exact digest binding, and PNG validation.

ClaimParents.$comment: Prose requires strict raw UTF-8 ordering, graph-local resolution, no self-edge, and acyclicity.

AdmittedFactExport.$comment: Prose requires exact RFC 8785 file bytes, one SQLite read snapshot, strict record order, and exclusion of encrypted bodies, SQLite bytes, and secrets.

CaptureReceipt.$comment: Prose requires exact RFC 8785 file bytes and equality with exact datagrams, the admitted-fact export, and the production Host commit trace.

HostCommitTrace.$comment: Prose requires exact RFC 8785 file bytes, strict event_seq and monotonic order, and records events only after successful commits.

ProvisioningReceipt.$comment: Prose requires exact RFC 8785 file bytes and exclusion of all secret-bearing provisioning material.

ProjectionStoreExport.$comment: Prose requires exact RFC 8785 file bytes exported from one SQLite read snapshot, strict ordering, and exclusion of SQLite pages, raw datagrams, and secrets.

PacketFactCommits.$comment: Prose requires strict numeric record_seq order and one-to-one binding to retained parent datagrams, projection-store-export packet facts, and Host commit-trace A/B events.

ProjectionReceipt.$comment: Prose requires exact RFC 8785 file bytes and validation against the Host commit trace and projection store export generated from live SQLite.

BrowserWebSocketTranscript.$comment: Prose requires exact RFC 8785 wrapper bytes and requires every text field to decode as exactly one api-ui-v1 LiveEnvelope with no trailing bytes.

TraceViewReceipt.$comment: The verifier additionally validates exact equality with api-ui-v1 $defs.ViewReceipt.

BrowserTrace.$comment: Prose requires exact RFC 8785 file bytes, strict event sequence and monotonic order, and cross-artifact/API validation.

DiagnosticUiAcceptanceReport.$comment: The independent verifier records raw queried DOM/accessibility/style observations and binds each behavior case to one passing graph browser claim, its BrowserTrace, and its PNG.

HostRestartReceipt.$comment: Prose requires exact RFC 8785 file bytes and ordered restart event times.

StorageQualificationReport.$comment: Prose requires exact RFC 8785 file bytes and equality with the storage claim and its environment.

ResourceWindowTiming.$comment: Runtime validation requires width_ns <= step_ns and snapshot_deadline_ns <= floor(step_ns / 2); this schema does not introduce a fixed deadline.

ResourceTailObservations.$comment: Runtime validation requires p95_ns <= p99_ns <= maximum_ns.

ResourceQualificationReport.$comment: Prose requires exact RFC 8785 file bytes, equality with the resource claim and its environment, and validation against evaluation v1 without inventing a fixed duration threshold.

checks.$comment: prefixItems fixes the strict raw UTF-8 token order required by prose.

ExecutionClaimGraph.$comment: Prose requires exact RFC 8785 file bytes and pre-DTO duplicate-member rejection.

claims.$comment: Prose requires strict raw UTF-8 ordering and uniqueness by claim id.

VerificationReceipt.$comment: Prose requires exact RFC 8785 file bytes, pre-DTO duplicate-member rejection, and hashing the validated original graph bytes.

root_claim_ids.$comment: Prose requires strict raw UTF-8 ordering, unique resolution to passing proof tips, and classification from their ancestor closure.

ProgramBrowserEvidence.$comment: This binding selects one independently verified live visible committed result; it does not assert the complete diagnostic UI acceptance surface.

ProgramCompletionReceipt.$comment: Prose requires exact RFC 8785 file bytes and independent verification of one graph, all four fixed classification receipts, passing restart/storage/resource claims, one final live visible committed browser result, and the bound diagnostic UI acceptance report.
